Take 6x from both sides: 3x + 4 = 16; take away 4: 3x = 12; divide by 3: x = 4. Check: both come to 40°. (∠X matches ∠B, not ∠C.) So x = 4.

prompt.v: △ABC ≅ △ZYX. AB = 2x − 17, YX = 3x − 27 and ZY = 3x − 29. What is ZY?

problems.text: use congruence: ABC = ZYX; AB 2x - 17, YX 3x - 27, ZY 3x - 29; find ZY
problems.explain: The order of the letters is the matching: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X. So AB matches ZY, and corresponding parts of congruent triangles are equal: 2x − 17 = 3x − 29. Take 2x from both sides: x − 29 = −17; add 29: x = 12. Then ZY = 3(12) − 29 = 7. (YX matches BC, not AB.) So ZY = 7.
